label: no
controls_available: The difficulty-5 puzzle has 15 heptagonal faces, an 8-twist scramble, and a 10-twist budget.
Full-mode mouse drag on the Poincare disc pans the view with a Mobius translation.
A short full-mode left-click on a face inside the central activation aperture applies a counter-clockwise twist; a short right-click applies a clockwise twist.
RESET SCRAMBLE synchronously restores the initial scramble and clears the local event and twist counters.
CERTIFY submits the current replay and is administrative; no outcome-affecting keyboard control is wired by this mechanic.

autonomous_processes.period: After render and between any two agent inputs
autonomous_processes.change: None: the sticker state, Mobius view, and twist count remain fixed; there is no timer, physics tick, idle animation, or background random update.
autonomous_processes.outcome_affecting_control: A valid full-mode canvas twist remains available until an explicit action, the move budget, submission, or the runner deadline.

autonomous_processes.change: Only clock-based runner termination can occur; it is not a non-clock task-state evolution.
autonomous_processes.outcome_affecting_control: Not a qualifying expiring opportunity under the frozen definition.

grouped_control_modes.name: full_canvas_twist
grouped_control_modes.scope: Every valid full-mode canvas-click twist, for either direction and every face, across seeds and attempts.

grouped_control_modes.name: full_mobius_pan
grouped_control_modes.scope: Every full-mode Mobius drag that changes the visible projection.

grouped_control_modes.name: reset_scramble
grouped_control_modes.scope: The explicit restart control, which synchronously returns to the generated initial state.
grouped_control_modes.role: restart control, not an autonomous opportunity

clause_i.reason: For the candidate full_canvas_twist mode at an early solvable state, the optimal next face and direction vary with the generated scramble, so an observation-free policy over only its prior action history cannot choose one optimal action across those histories. The generator enforces an exact eight-move minimum and the visible state determines the restoration move. This is static visual dependence, not dependence on autonomous change.

clause_ii.reason: A zero-width current screenshot contains the colored sticker state and the visible projected geometry. A screenshot-only solver can determine the next full-mode pan or centered twist, and waiting does not alter that state, so a bounded-window policy exists. The policy does not need to observe any autonomous process.

clause_iii.reason: No legitimate grouped mode has a qualifying autonomous evolution for any Delta greater than zero. Between inputs, the browser has no timer, animation loop, physics, or random updater; all view and sticker mutations occur synchronously in drag, click, or reset handlers. Thus a valid action remains equally effective after the delay and its advantage over no-op does not strictly decrease. Deadline-only loss is excluded by the definition.

common_visible_process: None. The only visible changes are synchronous consequences of the agent's own drag or click: dragging changes the view and clicking a centered face changes the sticker permutation. There is no visible autonomous process that could make a delayed action observation-dependent and simultaneously degrade its value.

pre_run.reason: The source implements no autonomous outcome phase. The configuration already fails the mathematical definition at clause (iii), so the pre-run threshold cannot override the No label.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 5 selects face_count 15, scramble_length 8, and move_budget 10; full interaction is a Mobius drag plus left/right canvas twist, with observation_window_ms 0 and one frame.
Generation consumes the control parameters to create a seeded initial scramble, fixed geometry, sticker cycles, and a static puzzle contract; it does not define a runtime clock or autonomous update.
The scramble is applied during generation and the solution is the reversed inverse scramble; the random source is used while generating the challenge, not between browser actions.
applyTwist synchronously checks the move budget, computes the permutation, increments twists, replaces model.current, redraws, and updates the panel.
Full-mode pointer handlers synchronously update the Mobius view during an agent drag and apply a twist on pointer release; there is no autonomous handler.
Reset synchronously restores the initial state, while submission only packages the current replay for /result.
Rendering initializes a fixed current state and identity view, installs event listeners, and calls draw; the complete mechanic contains no timer or animation loop.
The relevant CSS provides static layout, background, cursor, and overlay styling without an animation or transition declaration.
The grader replays pan and twist events, checks the visible interaction source, permutation, aperture, budget, and final monochrome state; it uses no elapsed-time or autonomous-state field.
The verifier independently replays the event transcript and validates only the resulting view/sticker state, counts, and solved condition.
The scripted solver computes a fixed solution sequence, focuses each target through the selected interaction surface, twists, and certifies without waiting for a task-state process.
The verifier helper only loads the exported JSON result from the task container; it contributes no task-time evolution.
